items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: That's all I know his name, Sleepy.

ctx.x: Well, now at times you had two trumpets. Who would carry the load, then? The other trumpeter?
Sleepy. That's all I know his name, Sleepy. Big, fat guy. I think he used to be with Jimmy Lunceford. I'm not sure. A fat fellow.
